note: Bridger-Teton NF campground in the trees beside Wild & Scenic Granite Creek, about 8 mi up Granite Creek Rd (FR 30500, gravel) from US-189/191, some 33 mi SE of Jackson. Most site spurs are posted at 16-28 ft: a 23-ft rig needs one of the sites listed at 24 ft or more. Granite Hot Springs pool ~0.7 mi N. --Claude
summary: FS page + FS site-length PDF + rec.gov 10352132: $20 (2026/2027), $10 extra vehicle, 52 numbered sites (FS fee line says 51; rec.gov lists 30 reservable), posted RV lengths 16-30 ft (21 sites take 24 ft+; stored max_rig_ft 45 was unsourced -> 30), 6 pull-throughs, no hookups, vault toilets + hydrants, closes Sep 15 (upper loop free after). Waterfront: creek-size channel (~16-27 m wet) 37-55 m from the nearest pads through a conifer/willow band; rec.gov 'No public river access through the campground' -> recommend creekside -> riverview.
flags: WATERFRONT (recommend creekside -> riverview): Granite Creek's wet channel is ~16-27 m wide beside the campground (creek-size, so creekside would be the on-water value). On Esri imagery with every rec.gov site plotted, the nearest pads are G21 (43.35806,-110.44502) ~37 m from the gravel bar's edge and ~80 m from the wet channel through continuous conifers, G47 (43.35483,-110.44304) ~43 m and G50 (43.35540,-110.44315) ~55 m from the channel through conifers and willow brush; the north loop (G04-G07) is ~90 m+ back across meadow. rec.gov notice: 'No public river access through the campground.' No site reaches the water over open ground within ~50 m; the FCFS sites not on rec.gov (2, 5, 8-12, 15, 16, 19, 22, 24, 25, 29, 33, 35, 42, 44, 46, 48, 51, 52) sit inside the same loops. Stored evidence ('forest-edge sites ~30-60m from channels') describes a view.

FIT CAVEAT (not a drop): FS posts RV lengths per site; 31 of the 52 sites are 16-22 ft and only 21 take 24 ft+ (longest 46 at 30 ft; rec.gov MaxVehicleLength 16-28 on its 30 reservable sites). Stored max_rig_ft 45 and the inclusion_evidence 'RVs to ~45 ft' have no source. Suggested inclusion_evidence: 'FS Granite Creek page + FS site-length table + recreation.gov 10352132: 52 drive-in sites, 21 posted at 24-30 ft, reservable + FCFS -> real drive-in RV campground (a 23-ft rig needs a 24 ft+ site)'.

FACILITIES CONFLICT: the FS page's amenity block says 'Potable water is not available at this site' while its general text lists 'water hydrants' and rec.gov lists 'Water Spigot'; potable_water kept true (the amenity line may reflect the off-season state).
